en: A vintage color postcard showing a coastal landscape with a small bay, cliffs, piers, boats, and scattered houses on a green hillside. The sea is calm and stretches to the horizon. At the top in red text it reads "Salut de Constantinople. Iles des Princes. Prinkipo." At the bottom right is a faint website watermark "www.elia.org.gr". The style and coloration suggest an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
